strings.en:
{0c:316000ec00921002501751003a00}{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Eleanor 】{0b:09}
Treasure, fame, eternal life... The
dreams, hopes and desires of people lie
sleeping in this land,{1a}and knowing the danger, they willingly set
foot in underground ruins where
monsters dwell...{1a}For a sense of duty, for a dream of
their own worth staking their lives on,{1a}for a loved one who waits, believing
in them...{1a}{0c:5121}The people here are too dazzling for
me now...{0c:1501}

strings.jp:

どんな崇{e09f}な使命よりも、
人ひとりの命の方が
はるかに重たい・・・{1a}あなたが何の為にこの町に

of others...{1a}Otherwise you will go on regretting it, as
